text: QUESTION: This "Reservations" read model only projects the "Table Reserved" event (column 1). Fixing this properly would mean moving/duplicating the read model to a column after all three events, which is a bigger structural change than this prompt's scope ("add next slice") — flagging here rather than guessing. Left the model as-is; a human should decide whether to reposition this read model or accept it as illustrative only.
